_note: Test customer type: Small physiotherapy clinics in Finland. Product klinikflow, pricing setup_retainer (one-off setup fee plus a monthly fee, minimum term). Fictional.
offer: Klinikflow cuts no-shows and phone time for private clinics with online booking, deposits and SMS reminders.
product_info: Klinikflow is online booking and patient messaging for private clinics. Patients book and pay a deposit online, get SMS reminders, and can move their own appointment; the clinic sees fewer no-shows and spends less time on the phone. It connects to the clinic's journal system and works on any phone.
tone: Plain, short and specific. No hype words and no exclamation marks. One clear ask. Max 120 words for a first email.

auto_close.standard_terms: List price, standard terms, no custom contract

standard.for: Monthly service after a one-off setup

pricing.deal_policy: No discount without an admin; the setup fee is never discounted.
